title: Retail Revenue Optimization
summary: Identified a 15% revenue decline and surfaced root causes using SQL and Power BI, enabling data-driven promotional decisions.
problem: The client faced a consistent 15% revenue decline over 3 months with no clear root cause identified from existing spreadsheet reports.
solution: Built an end-to-end SQL pipeline to clean and aggregate POS data, then created a Power BI dashboard exposing underperforming SKUs, seasonal demand gaps, and regional discrepancies.
outcome: Enabled targeted promotions that improved revenue by 12% in the following quarter. Reduced reporting time from 3 days to 4 hours.

title: HR Attrition Dashboard
summary: Designed a Power BI dashboard giving HR teams full visibility into employee attrition patterns and department-level risk.
problem: HR team had no visibility into which departments were losing talent, why employees were leaving, or which roles were most at risk.
solution: Cleaned and modeled employee exit survey data using Python (pandas). Built a multi-page Power BI report with attrition predictors, department drill-downs, and sentiment scoring from exit interviews.
outcome: Reduced manual HR reporting time by 60%. HR team used insights to restructure onboarding in 2 high-attrition departments.

title: E-Commerce Customer Segmentation
summary: Applied RFM analysis and clustering to segment 50,000+ customers for targeted marketing campaigns.
problem: Marketing team was running identical campaigns across all customers, resulting in low conversion rates and high unsubscribe rates.
solution: Used Python to run RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) scoring on transaction history, then applied K-Means clustering to segment customers into 5 distinct behavioral groups.
outcome: Segmented campaigns achieved 3x higher click-through rate. High-value segment identified, contributing 40% of total revenue.
